# `<ds-chat-thread>` — `ChatThreadComponent`

Group: Display & feedback

Scrollable list of `ds-chat-message`s; give it a height (or `flex: 1` in a column). Stays at the newest message as messages arrive or grow; once the reader scrolls up it stays put and shows a jump button with the count of messages that arrived below (`DS_INTL.chat.newMessages(count)`, `latest` when none). A message with `role="user"` arriving scrolls back down. Consecutive messages of one role sit at `--ds-chat-thread-group-gap`, speakers apart at `--ds-chat-thread-gap`; inside a run the corners on the speaker's side are tight (`--ds-radius-inner`). With `sentAt` on the messages, a gap of `timeBreakMinutes` (default `15`) or more starts a new run under a centred divider (`DS_INTL.chat.today` / `yesterday` or the date, then the time, in `DsConfig.locale`); the first dated message gets one too. `working` shows a spinner row with `workingLabel` (else `DS_INTL.chat.working`) at the end; never put a time estimate in it. Screen readers: the list is not a live region; the thread announces a finished assistant reply once (when it arrives while not `working`, or when `working` clears) and the working label, and never the messages present at first render. Method: `scrollToEnd()`.
Tokens: `--ds-chat-thread-gap`, `--ds-chat-thread-group-gap`, `--ds-chat-thread-padding`.

All inputs: `working: boolean = false`, `workingLabel: string = ''`, `ariaLabel: string | null = null`, `timeBreakMinutes: number = 15`
